freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 注册后赠送试用额度，邀请好友注册可额外获得额度；统一兼容 OpenAI 接口，聚合 DeepSeek、GLM、Qwen 等模型。具体赠送额度与活动规则以控制台为准。
freeTierSummary.en: New accounts receive trial credits, with extra credits for inviting friends; the gateway offers OpenAI-compatible access to DeepSeek, GLM and Qwen models. Check the console for current credit amounts and promotion rules.
